ActionEffect.description:
What an action does to the world beyond the run, as its declaration says.

``INTERNAL`` is work the run does for itself (cloning a repository, reading a page): it
runs when the graph asks. ``PUBLISHES`` puts something in front of other people and
``SPENDS`` costs money; the gate holds both for a person's approval.

delete.description:
Delete the project with everything stored about it, for good.

That is its analyses, the evidence they found, every profile version, its
proposals, its chats and its research runs with their reports and the pages
they fetched. Refused while an analysis or a research run of the project is
queued or running, or a proposal of it waits for a decision. 503
`storage_unavailable` when the research pages' objects could not be removed
from object storage; the project stays then. The repository is not touched.

post.description:
Answer one operator message in the chat, and store the exchange.

201 with the stored question and answer. 409 `model_key_not_set`,
`credential_unreadable` or `stored_setting_invalid` when the turn's model
cannot be resolved. 503 `chat_unanswered` when the agent gave no answer
within its limits and `model_unavailable` when the provider could not
answer; nothing is stored then, and sending the message again starts the
turn again. A turn may start a research run when the operator asks for
research (the request action `start_research`), and says so in the answer;
a run whose workflow could not be started is recorded as failed and the
answer says it could not be started.

Record that the operator has read the chat up to now; it is no longer unread.

The request takes no body; one is a 422.

post.description:
Queue a research run for the questions and return the run to poll.

A worker executes it later; a project may have several runs at once. 503
`research_not_started` when the run could not be handed to a worker: it is
then stored as failed and a new one can be started.

delete.description:
Delete a finished run with its report and the pages it fetched, for good.

409 `research_unfinished` while the run is queued or running: the worker
would store pages or a report for a run that is gone. 503
`storage_unavailable` when the pages' objects could not be removed from
object storage; the run stays then, and can be deleted again. The request
takes no body; one is a 422.

get.description: The run as it is now: queued, running, succeeded (with the report) or failed.

The report of a run that succeeded, with the evidence of every finding.

404 `research_report_not_found` while the run has no report: it is
unfinished or it failed.
